column1: Does this X-ray have tuberculosis? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1}
Does it have the ET Tube and what is the distance between the Carina and the ET Tube? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "DISTANCE": FLOAT}
Is there nodules in this X-ray and if so where is the nodule? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING}
Does this X-ray contain any fractures? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING, "BOUNDING_BOX": [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax]}
Is the Mediastinum normal? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"NORMAL": 0 or 1, "FINDINGS": STRING}
What disease can you find in the left lung? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"LEFT_LUNG": ["list of diseases"]}
What disease can you find in the right lung? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"RIGHT_LUNG": ["list of diseases"]}
Is there any evidence of pneumothorax? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING}
Can you locate the Pleural effusion? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING}
Is there pneumonia and can you locate the Pneumonia? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING}
Is there evidence of hilar lymphadenopathy? RESPONSE IN JSON WITH {"EXIST": 0 or 1, "LOCATION": STRING}
